targets.title: 1/f noise and effort on implicit measures of bias.
targets.evidence_quote: In two large samples, we attempted to replicate Correll’s (2008) Study 2 main finding using the exact same procedures, experimental manipulation, measures, stimuli, task instructions, sampling frame, and population.
targets.outcome_quote: As is shown in Fig. 1, we were not able to replicate Correll’s (2008) Study 2 main finding in both of our samples.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Both attempts fail to reproduce the central manipulation effect; authors explicitly call the attempts unsuccessful. Presence of general 1/f noise is a baseline observation, not success on the targeted modulation. Bayesian comparison to original summaries is not an independent reanalysis target.

reasoning: Two independent new samples directly re-test Study 2 of Correll (2008). Correll (2011), general 1/f sources and behavioral task references are background, not independently targeted published findings.
